name: Overlord Mok'Morokk's Concern
summary: Overlord Mok'Morokk of the Stonemaul clan is in Brackenwall Village and wants his grog, snuff and strongbox back. He left them behind in a hurry at the clan's old home, and he sends you south to find them.

sections.title: The Overlord's Story
sections.body: Mok'Morokk says Rexxar made him the mighty leader of the Stonemaul clan, and that he keeps his people safe. By his account, big dragons came to the old home and brought fire, so he found the clan a new home here in Dustwallow.

sections.title: Things Left Behind
sections.body: He left the old home so fast that he forgot his belongings: his grog, his snuff and his strongbox. He points you south, to the Den of Flame and the Stonemaul Ruins, and is sure they are there. He says he is too busy leading the ogres to go himself.

faq.answer: Overlord Mok'Morokk leads the Stonemaul clan from Brackenwall Village. By his own telling, Rexxar made him the clan's mighty leader.

faq.q: What happened to the Stonemaul clan's old home?
faq.answer: Mok'Morokk says big dragons came and brought fire to the old home, so he found the clan a new home at Brackenwall Village.
He wants his grog, his snuff and his strongbox, which he forgot when he left the old home in a hurry.
He sends you south and is sure the belongings are in the Den of Flame and the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Why doesn't Mok'Morokk fetch his things himself?
faq.answer: He says he is too busy leading the ogres to go and get them.
